    Dispatches AbstractBigViewer.applyAutoBrightness(BrightnessScope) for a given scope: the single current source, every currently active source (ViewerState.isSourceActive(bdv.viewer.SourceAndConverter<?>)), or (for ALL) the whole scene via the aggregate AbstractBigViewer.initBrightnessSafely(bdv.viewer.ViewerState, bdv.viewer.ConverterSetups, String).
